description_expanded: Refined Coastal Living with Space & Style Ideal for couples, families, or upscale retreats. Designed for relaxation, connection, and uninterrupted views of the Gulf. Large Sofa Pit & Flat-Screen TV – A comfy spot for movie nights or post-beach lounging. Chef’s Kitchen – Outfitted with high-end appliances, premium finishes, and everything needed to prepare gourmet meals or beach-day snacks. Breakfast Bar & Dining Table – Offers casual and formal seating options for meals and conversation. Sophisticated Bedrooms for Restful Sleep Master Suite with King Bed – Luxuriously appointed for comfort and serenity. Two Guest Rooms with Queen Beds – Designed with plush furnishings and elegant details. Spa-Like Bathrooms – Immaculately maintained with premium fixtures and finishes. Breathtaking Outdoor Spaces & Exclusive Extras Private Balcony with Gulf Views – Unwind with a drink in hand as you watch the waves or toast the sunset. Paddleboard + 6 Bikes Included – Explore 30A’s trails, beaches, and coastal dune lakes like a local. Gated Gulf-Front Community – Enjoy peace of mind and exclusivity in one of West 30A’s premier neighborhoods. Full-Size Washer & Dryer – Convenience meets comfort for extended stays. Start your day with a dip in the community pool or rent beach chair service via private beach access just steps from your door. Grab a bike and explore Timpoochee Trail, a 19-mile paved bike bath that traverses through 16 communities along 30A. Grab a bite at Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar, Goatfeathers, or Local Catch Bar and Grill, all just minutes away! Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund. 4 bikes are included with the rental. These bikes belong to the home and must be left locked at the home upon departure. Please report damage to the bikes, if any. Please Note: The top floor balcony bedroom is closed off and not to be used by guests.
